questions.question: Discuss the significance of cultural identity in 'The Sacrificial Egg' and its relevance to contemporary society. / [CO2, CO4, CO5, CO6] [1X15=15]
questions.solution_html:
• The story shows cultural identity through Julius’s conflict between his Western education
  • and the traditional Igbo beliefs he witnesses in the market, the rituals, and the sacrificial egg
  • he accidentally steps on. Although he knows such beliefs have no place in rational thinking,
  • the later deaths of Ma and Janet—and the empty market he looks out on—force him to
  • confront the community’s traditional explanations and the power those beliefs hold. The
  • story remains relevant because it depicts how individuals still navigate the tension between
  • modern ideas and deeply rooted cultural practices. (CO2, CO4, CO5, CO6)
